title: skills: bootstrap.md teaches composeStacks without saying a suite composes under manifest 'preserve', now that a flat composition with two or more apps under one app or module package is refused
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgU7jN46DmQ6XFvz28s

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up the product PR owes. PR #32898 (for #32810) declares `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md, skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`; product PRs do not edit `skills/**`, so the seat files it. The `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` half is already carried by #32809; this card is the `bootstrap.md` half only.

Reader: the `domain:skills` lane (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md`, § Multi-App Composition).

## 维护者速读

#32810 让 `composeStacks` 拒绝扁平组合出「一个 app/module 包 id 下挂两个以上应用」。给 AI 看的 bootstrap 说明书在「多应用组合」一节介绍了 `composeStacks` 的 `manifest` 策略，但没说套件要用 `'preserve'` 组合，还写着本仓没有应用用它（`examples/app-multi-package` 其实在用）。AI 照着写扁平组合，PR 落地后会被拒，白跑一轮。

## Work

1. In § Multi-App Composition, say that a suite of packages composes with `composeStacks(stacks, { manifest: 'preserve' })`, and that a flat option (`'last'`, `'first'`, an index) is refused with `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` (422) when two or more apps would land under one `app` or `module` package id.
2. Correct the sentence that no app in this repo uses `'preserve'`: `examples/app-multi-package/objectstack.config.ts` does.
3. Teach only what is on `main` when this card's PR is cut: if #32898 has not merged yet, this card waits for it.

## Sequencing

Lands with or after PR #32898 (#32810), which itself lands after the 18.4.0 version commit (ruling 6838530241).

## Dedupe

Suggested words: `bootstrap.md composeStacks preserve`, `skills Multi-App Composition manifest`. Related: #32809 (the `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` half), #32810.

Suggested-grade: p2 · a docs follow-up of a p1 narrowing; it costs an AI author one refused round until fixed.

Blocked-by: #32810
